start: Member with a plan adds the "Today" widget

steps.action: Add the Today widget to the home screen
user_sees: Today's routine name, its line, up to two "what to beat" lines, and "Start"
must_not: "Open MettleUp to see your workout" when the app has data

steps.action: Tap the widget
user_sees: Today's routine starts in one tap
must_not: The Workout tab with nothing started

steps.action: Look at the widget during the workout
user_sees: "Workout in progress" and "Resume"

steps.action: Finish the workout and look again
user_sees: Today closed or the next routine

start: Member adds the "This week" widget

steps.action: Add the This week widget
user_sees: Days trained this week as filled marks, today ringed, a count line

steps.action: Tap it
user_sees: The Profile with its chart and workouts

start: Member opens the widget hint in the app on a launcher that cannot add widgets

steps.action: Tap the add-widget button
user_sees: "Your home screen can't add it from here. Long-press your home screen → Widgets → MettleUp."

start: New member with no data, or a widget added before the app was opened

steps.action: Add both widgets
user_sees: Today: "Open MettleUp to see your workout" and "Open"
This week: "Open MettleUp to update"

start: Phone not opened for a few days, widget on the home screen

steps.action: Look at the widget the next morning
user_sees: The new day's routine without opening the app

steps.action: Look on a Monday
user_sees: A fresh week, no days filled

steps.action: Erase all data in the app
user_sees: Widgets back to "Open MettleUp"
must_not: Old routine or what-to-beat weights still shown
